title: Blaze Deployment Platform
topic: Everyone Is a Developer: how Blaze auto-deploys apps built by anyone, in any tool, and owns compliance end to end
summary: Pitch deck for Blaze: anyone builds or changes an app at scale in any tool, and Blaze deploys it and owns compliance automatically — templates, tools, environments, and a compliance status thread tie the story together.
key_claims: Blaze's premise is that anyone can build or change an app; deployment and compliance are automated away from the builder.
Templates are the source of truth; apps flow from any authoring tool through Blaze into governed environments.
Compliance is owned by the platform as a continuous status thread, not a manual gate at the end.
